services.name: Adult Karate
services.desc: Shotokan Karate was founded by Grandmaster Gichin Funakoshi who studied Te under Grandmaster Itosu and Grandmaster Higaonna in Okinawa, Japan. Back then, Karate was called Te (hand), and different types of Te were studied in various areas of Okinawa. Grandmaster Funakoshi was the first Karate-ka to introduce Te to mainland Japan. He demonstrated his Karate at the physical education Expo held in Tokyo in 1921. Funakoshi was supposed to stay for only a short period of time, but Jigoro Kano, the founder of Judo, was impressed by Funakoshi’s Karate, and persuaded him to stay longer to teach Karate at the Kodokan (the Mecca of Judo). blurb: Doshi-Kai Karate Club, Inc. has been teaching traditional martial arts in the greater Boston area since 1984, and prides itself on teaching all of our students in a focused but friendly environment. Doshi-Kai offers karate classes for men, women and adolescents age 14 and above. The classes are open to all ranks.
